comment: Teletype's trigger outputs go to 10V, not the 8V the plugin's general voltage page gives for TR outs elsewhere; both figures are the maker's own, on docs/content/modules/teletype.md and docs/content/general/voltage.md respectively. The trigger inputs are the one place in the plugin where a rising edge is acted on immediately rather than at the downsampled input rate, which the maker's voltage page calls out as the exception. Two shortcut menu items are present in the source but commented out — a GRID visualizer mode and a system variables toggle — so they are not written here. The input index order is IN first, then TRIGGER 1 to 8; the panel puts the eight trigger jacks across the top with the in jack at the right of the first row.
